legacy_implied_expectations_NOT_REVALIDA.valuation_method: Ten-year DCF reverse expectations; current-cohort cash flows are adjusted for annual dilution.
legacy_implied_expectations_NOT_REVALIDA.interpretation: Even at a 30%-40% year-10 FCF margin, the price requires roughly 30%-34% revenue CAGR for a full decade. This is unrealistic Bull-case-or-better execution relative to FY2026 guidance growth of about 32%.

current_findings: 현재 분석가의 Bull 가치가 가격보다 낮다는 사실만으로 모든 현실적 Bull을 배제한 것은 아니다. 가격 Hard Veto는 FAIL→INVESTIGATE로 수정한다. 다만 높은 기대·희석과 58점의 낮은 투자매력 때문에 최종 REJECT는 유지한다.
기준가 281.44달러, TTM 매출 약 25.12억 달러와 SBC 약 5.08억 달러. 보고 FCF 약 3.15억 달러보다 SBC가 크다. 높은 매출 성장만으로 주당 경제가치 성장이 확인되지는 않는다.
implied_expectations.current_model_limit: 총마진·고객 유지와 SBC 이후 FCF/주 개선, 완전희석 주식수를 포함한 현실적 성장 범위 및 지배구조를 확인한다.

method_changes: All three cases use US 9% discount rate and 3% terminal company-FCF growth.
Unlisted investments excluded; inherited liquid financial assets are a proxy, not all proven excess cash.
No free negative dilution. Positive dilution continues in the terminal period.
Reported-FCF compensation/repurchase/interest-income bridge is incomplete; outputs are diagnostic, not actionable fair values.

bear.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

base.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

bull.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

bear.narrative: Integrated-cloud competition and lower AI monetization push growth toward single digits; network and third-party costs limit margin expansion.

base.narrative: Cloudflare sustains strong near-term growth and executes security, SASE and developer cross-sell, but growth normalizes and SBC dilution persists.

bull.narrative: Cloudflare becomes a leading independent control plane for the Agentic Internet, security, SASE and edge compute while producing exceptional margin and dilution discipline.

drivers: AI traffic raises inference, third-party technology and bandwidth costs faster than monetization.
DBNR approaches 100% and revenue growth drops below 20% as cloud and security vendors bundle competing products.
Long-run FCF margin stalls near 18%, annual dilution remains about 3%, and founder control delays capital-allocation changes.
Convertible-note settlement and Class C issuance erode per-share value despite low bankruptcy risk.
permanent_loss_case.type: valuation and dilution-driven permanent capital impairment, not the central bankruptcy case

notes:
2026-09-05 재심사: 상위 scenarios와 legacy_implied_expectations는 복구·보존한 과거 추정치이며 승인된 현재 가치가 아니다. 최신 판단은 re-evaluation-2026-09-05.md, 통일 허들 진단은 implied_expectations.uniform_hurdle_diagnostic(해당 종목)을 참조. 보고 FCF와 owner-FCFE의 비용·희석 브리지는 미완성이다. 총점 보류 종목의 상위 기대차/비대칭 점수도 과거 스냅샷이다.
기존 모델 메모(과거): Facts: price snapshot, market capitalization and filed historical figures. Estimates: TTM calculations, pro-forma net cash, all DCF values and probabilities. Inference: current price requires unrealistic Bull-case-or-better execution. The DCF is highly sensitive to discount rate, terminal margin, growth duration and dilution; it is an expectations test, not a precise target price. Macro is excluded from valuation and the 100-point company score.
